fix: and likewise of the Epirotes and Acarnanians [...] and of how many benefits he was in a short time the cause to each of them.

fix: Therefore the soldiers there stood speechless and at the same time overjoyed, some amazed by the strangeness of the thing, others foreseeing and fearing what would happen.
reason: οἱ μὲν ... οἱ δὲ splits two groups; all were ἀχανεῖς and περιχαρεῖς; 'dread' as a shared feeling is not in the Greek.
